name: Auto Research
description:
Autonomous skill improvement through parallel research agents. Inspired by Karpathy's autoresearch methodology, it spawns 5 parallel agents (domain expert, quality auditor, competitive analyst, gap analyst, tech scout), synthesizes findings
into ranked proposals, then runs an iterative keep/discard experiment loop to improve any Claude Code skill. Scores skills on 7 quality dimensions and only keeps changes that genuinely improve the composite score.
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, `auto-research` (Autonomous skill improvement through parallel research agents).

Installs with `claude plugin install auto-research@claude-community` from `gyoz-ai/auto-research`.
